headword: {販売促進|はんばいそくしん}

definitions.gloss: sales promotion; marketing promotion; activities to boost sales
definitions.explanation: Activities and strategies designed to increase product or service sales, such as discounts, campaigns, giveaways, and advertising pushes.

examples.japanese: {販売促進|はんばいそくしん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦キャンペーン→キャンペーン：10809_kyanpeen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: We launched a sales promotion campaign.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新商品|しんしょうひん}→新商品：11504_shinshouhin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{販売促進|はんばいそくしん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れている→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: We are putting effort into promoting the new product.

examples.japanese: {販売促進|はんばいそくしん}{費|ひ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{年間|ねんかん}→年間：00974_nenkan⟧⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{割合|わりあい}→割合：01760_wariai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{占|し}めている→占める：11799_shimeru⟧。
examples.english: Sales promotion costs account for a large share of the annual budget.

notes:
A four-character compound of ⟦{販売|はんばい}→販売：03573_hanbai⟧ (sales) + ⟦{促進|そくしん}→促進：05632_sokushin⟧ (promotion, facilitation). Very commonly abbreviated to ⟦{販促|はんそく}→販促：17109_hansoku⟧ in business conversation and internal documents. A standard term in marketing, retail, and business planning.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {販売促進|はんばいそくしん}⟦キャンペーン→キャンペーン：10809_kyanpeen⟧: sales promotion campaign
- {販売促進|はんばいそくしん}{費|ひ}: sales promotion expenses
- {販売促進|はんばいそくしん}⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧: promotional activities
- {販売促進|はんばいそくしん}⟦{担当|たんとう}→担当：02567_tantou⟧: person in charge of sales promotion
- {販売促進|はんばいそくしん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to put effort into sales promotion

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{販促|はんそく}→販促：17109_hansoku⟧: sales promotion (abbreviation) — the same meaning, used more casually and frequently in daily business
- ⟦{宣伝|せんでん}→宣伝：03307_senden⟧: advertising, publicity — broader term focused on spreading awareness rather than directly boosting sales
- ⟦マーケティング→マーケティング：05222_maaketingu⟧: marketing — the overall discipline, of which sales promotion is one component
